description: Issue #145, exclusion 4 of 4: 「テストは変更しない」/ "leave the tests unchanged". The strongest statement of the four — the author is saying the very file this detector would ask for must NOT be touched, so raising a question that asks for it inverts the issue's intent. Both criteria carry an active verb about the implementation (書き換える / "Add") next to a test noun, so the positive rule fires the moment this exclusion is removed.
